name: psych-battery-app
description: Psych Battery is a UC Berkeley research app that visualizes a user's mental energy as a pixel-art battery. The frontend is a single-file vanilla JS app (`index.html`, no build step, no npm). The backend is a Python Flask server (in the `dpm-research-hub` repo) that runs a two-compartment ODE model tracking energy and stress across the day, fed by real-time data from ActivityWatch, Slack, Google Calendar, Zoom, Todoist, Apple Health, and more.
